sources.entry: Gramps Web - Web app for collaborative genealogy, based on and interoperable with Gramps, the open source genealogy desktop application. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: A Python REST API that lets you query and edit Gramps family tree databases over the web, serving as the backend for the Gramps Web genealogy app.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Gramps Web API as a Python REST API for Gramps that allows querying and manipulating a Gramps family tree database via the web. It is the backend of the Gramps Web genealogy web app and is stated to be usable as a backend for other tools as well. The README itself is brief and mostly links to external documentation: API docs, developer docs, and Gramps Web user docs, plus the separate Gramps Web frontend repository. Installation and usage details are not in the README text provided. Per awesome-selfhosted, it is listed under Genealogy and is also available as a Docker deployment with a demo.
use_cases: Host a shared family tree database on the web
Build a custom genealogy tool on top of Gramps data
Query people, families and events of a Gramps tree via HTTP
Provide a backend for the Gramps Web genealogy app
Collaborate on a family tree in a browser
notable: Backend for the Gramps Web genealogy web app
Operates on Gramps family tree databases over HTTP
Can be used as a backend for other tools, not only Gramps Web
Interoperable with the Gramps desktop application
caveats: README is brief and defers setup and usage details to external documentation
Install and run steps are not given in the README text
Requires an existing Gramps family tree database to be useful
